description: Register a body you own (starts 'pending' until an operator approves it). You must declare how it is controlled: manifest.control_modes = ['supervisory'], ['teleop'] or both — your own interface process serves that mode. Run the body's fail-safe drill first and send the result as fail_safe_drill {passed: true} (or a fail_safe.verified_at from the last 90 days). Declare manifest.robot_type and manifest.capabilities so renters can find it. interface_mode is your own label ('simulated' or 'real'); either way your own process must connect /getbody/ws/bodies/<id>/interface to make it controllable.

fail_safe.description: mode, heartbeat_interval_ms, trigger_after_ms; verified_at if your last drill was in the last 90 days.

fail_safe_drill.description: The fail-safe drill you just ran on this body: {passed, notes}. A passing one satisfies the recent-drill requirement for a new body.

manifest.description: REQUIRED: control_modes — non-empty list of 'supervisory' and/or 'teleop'. Strongly encouraged, so renters and find_robot_for_task can find it: robot_type (humanoid, quadruped, wheeled, arm, drone or other) and capabilities (any of move, grip, see, hear_speak, other). Also e.g. model, dof, payload_kg, reach_m, sensors[].

name: create_body
title: Register a robot body
